prompts.paragraph: Front-view anchor packshot of a single hoodie for the product page, shown as a ghost-mannequin catalogue shot with the body shape filled out and no visible mannequin. The garment is an oversized pullover hoodie in 450 GSM cotton-rich fleece: oversized boxy fit, dropped shoulder, wide body, slightly cropped length. The 450 GSM fabric stands away from the body, with thick rib and a hood that keeps its shape. The colour is Washed Black (#2F2F31). Construction: double-layer hood with centre seam; flat drawcords with metal aglets, through metal eyelets; kangaroo pocket, openings symmetrical, attached at the hem; 2x2 rib cuffs and hem, distinct from the body fabric; and coverstitched seams. The garment is plain and unbranded. Clearly visible: both drawcords with metal aglets, the full kangaroo pocket, and rib cuffs and hem. The camera is straight on at chest height, with a 50mm lens, whole garment centred with even margins on all sides. Soft, even studio light from a large overhead softbox with gentle front fill, showing the fleece texture. Seamless light grey studio background with a soft natural shadow below the hem. Style: clean editorial streetwear catalogue, true-to-life colour, soft natural contrast, no film grain.
